articles.title: Enhancing iNKT cell immunotherapy through the integration of optimized CAR endodomains and iNKT engagers
articles.abstract: Abstract iNKT cells are emerging as a highly promising immunotherapy platform for the treatment of cancer. To maximise the anti-cancer activity of CAR-iNKT against the blood cancer multiple myeloma we investigated optimal CAR designs and their combination with new iNKT-specific engagers. We find that amongst five different CAR endodomains, underpinned by increased avidity and a cross talk between Plexin D1 on CAR-iNKT and Semaphorin 4 A on myeloma cells, BCMA CD28z CAR-iNKT exert the highest anti-myeloma activity. Notably, CD28z CAR-iNKT outperform their CAR-T counterparts. To expand the anti-myeloma potential of CAR-iNKT, we designed and validated a high efficacy BCMA iNKT-specific engager which exerts significant anti-myeloma activity in conjunction with adoptively transferred iNKT cells. Finally, combined, dual target therapy with FCRL5 CAR-iNKT and BCMA iNKT engagers outperforms FCRL5 CAR-iNKT and limits immune escape of FCRL5-negative myeloma. Thus, optimised iNKT-based, dual-target, dual-modality immunotherapy has enhanced anti-tumor activity against multiple myeloma and potentially other malignancies.
articles.title_zh: 通过整合优化的 CAR 内域和 iNKT 接合剂增强 iNKT 细胞免疫治疗
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 iNKT 细胞正在成为一种非常有前景的癌症免疫治疗平台。为了最大限度地发挥 CAR-iNKT 对血癌多发性骨髓瘤的抗癌活性，我们研究了最佳 CAR 设计及其与新的 iNKT 特异性接合剂的组合。我们发现，在五种不同的 CAR 内域中，由于亲和力增加以及 CAR-iNKT 上的 Plexin D1 和骨髓瘤细胞上的 Semaphorin 4 A 之间的串扰，BCMA CD28z CAR-iNKT 发挥了最高的抗骨髓瘤活性。值得注意的是，CD28z CAR-iNKT 的性能优于 CAR-T 同类产品。为了扩大 CAR-iNKT 的抗骨髓瘤潜力，我们设计并验证了一种高效的 BCMA iNKT 特异性接合器，它与过继转移的 iNKT 细胞结合发挥显着的抗骨髓瘤活性。最后，使用 FCRL5 CAR-iNKT 和 BCMA iNKT 接合剂的联合双靶向治疗优于 FCRL5 CAR-iNKT，并限制了 FCRL5 阴性骨髓瘤的免疫逃逸。因此，优化的基于 iNKT 的双靶点、双模式免疫疗法增强了针对多发性骨髓瘤和其他潜在恶性肿瘤的抗肿瘤活性。

articles.title: Cell Painting in activated cells illuminates phenotypic dark space and drug mechanisms of action
articles.abstract: Abstract As drug and natural product libraries expand, assays for assessing mechanisms of action (MoA) are increasingly critical. Performing cytological profiling using the Cell Painting (CP) assay enables image-based profiling of cellular states upon treatment, yet many bioactive compounds remain uncharacterized due to undetectable cellular effects under standard conditions. To address this, we combine drug dosing with cell activation using the protein kinase C (PKC) agonist phorbol myristate acetate (PMA). Profiling A549 lung cancer cells treated with 8,387 compounds at two concentrations (1 and 10 µM) in both resting and PMA-activated states enables detection of phenotypic effects for up to 40% of all screened compounds, effectively illuminating more phenotypic ‘dark space.’ The combined cellular CP fingerprints from PMA-activated and resting cells reveal phenotypes for 565 compounds that are inactive under the resting condition alone, supporting its use in MoA studies. We introduce quality control measures for CP screens and demonstrate that integrating phenotypic signatures supports MoA discovery. Notably, 2-methoxycinnamaldehyde clusters with glucocorticoid receptor modulators and induces nuclear translocation, emphasizing the utility of this approach in identifying drug mechanisms and, therefore, aiding in improving therapeutic strategies.
articles.title_zh: 激活细胞中的细胞绘画阐明了表型暗空间和药物作用机制
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 随着药物和天然产物库的扩大，评估作用机制 (MoA) 的测定方法变得越来越重要。使用细胞绘画 (CP) 测定进行细胞学分析可以对治疗后的细胞状态进行基于图像的分析，但由于在标准条件下无法检测到细胞效应，许多生物活性化合物仍未得到表征。为了解决这个问题，我们使用蛋白激酶 C (PKC) 激动剂佛波醇肉豆蔻酸酯乙酸酯 (PMA) 将药物剂量与细胞激活结合起来。对在静息和 PMA 激活状态下用两种浓度（1 和 10 µM）的 8,387 种化合物处理的 A549 肺癌细胞进行分析，可以检测到所有筛选化合物中高达 40% 的表型效应，有效地照亮更多表型“暗空间”。来自 PMA 激活和静息细胞的组合细胞 CP 指纹揭示了在静息条件下不活跃的 565 种化合物的表型单独，支持其在 MoA 研究中的使用。我们引入了 CP 筛选的质量控制措施，并证明整合表型特征支持 MoA 发现。值得注意的是，2-甲氧基肉桂醛与糖皮质激素受体调节剂聚集并诱导核易位，强调了这种方法在识别药物机制方面的效用，因此有助于改进治疗策略。

articles.title: Dynamism and evolvability in nucleic acid enzymes
articles.abstract: Abstract Protein dynamism and evolvability are key parameters linking enzyme flexibility to adaptive potential, yet how these concepts apply to nucleic acid enzymes remains largely unexplored. Here, we propose that threose nucleic acid (TNA), a genetic polymer that is more conformationally restricted than DNA, may be evolutionarily constrained by its preorganized backbone. RNA-cleavage profiles comparing the well-known 10-23 DNA enzyme (DNAzyme) with two in vitro selected TNA enzymes (threozymes) reveal striking differences in their temperature dependence. While the DNAzyme catalyzed reaction is optimal at 37 °C and weakly active at 50 °C, threozymes display the opposite trend, suggesting that TNA catalysis must overcome a higher free-energy barrier than DNA catalysis. Consistent with this view, the reaction becomes less temperature dependent for threozymes that operate with more flexible active sites. Together, these findings highlight the importance of backbone structure as a critical parameter for evolvability with implications for RNA world models and biomedical applications.
articles.title_zh: 核酸酶的动态性和进化性
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 蛋白质动态性和进化性是将酶的灵活性与适应潜力联系起来的关键参数，但这些概念如何应用于核酸酶仍然很大程度上尚未得到探索。在这里，我们提出，苏糖核酸（TNA）是一种构象比 DNA 更受限制的遗传聚合物，在进化上可能受到其预先组织的主链的限制。将著名的 10-23 DNA 酶 (DNAzyme) 与两种体外选择的 TNA 酶 (苏酶) 的 RNA 切割谱进行比较，揭示了它们在温度依赖性方面的显着差异。虽然 DNAzyme 催化反应在 37 °C 时最佳，在 50 °C 时活性较弱，但苏酶则表现出相反的趋势，表明 TNA 催化必须克服比 DNA 催化更高的自由能垒。与这一观点一致，对于具有更灵活的活性位点的苏酶来说，反应对温度的依赖性降低。总之，这些发现强调了主链结构作为进化性关键参数的重要性，对 RNA 世界模型和生物医学应用具有影响。

articles.title:
Oxidative Stress
after Pollutant Exposure Depends
Strongly on Experimental Design and Pollutant Properties in Annelids:
A Meta-Analysis
articles.abstract: Abstract Measurements of oxidative stress are often performed to assess a species’ general sublethal stress response to a pollutant. However, oxidative stress bioassays often produce seemingly ambiguous results, and the drivers that lead to these differences are largely unknown. To address this gap, we conducted a meta-analysis on reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation, ROS-associated damage products, enzyme activities, and gene expression levels in response to exposures to two groups of pollutants, nano- and microplastic particles (NMP) and neonicotinoid insecticides (neonics). Based on 2294 ROS-related measurements extracted from 45 studies, we show that measured effects vary substantially, with a strong overlap of measured effects with zero. As likely drivers of this variance, we identified multiple parameters of experimental design and pollutant properties. Finally, we performed data simulations and power analyses to investigate how well single experiments are able to detect oxidative stress-related effects. While most oxidative stress markers achieve sufficient power (80%) to demonstrate effects with sample sizes N < 20, conclusions derived from single studies with low sample sizes (N < 5) are at risk of being less informative than previously assumed. Our results highlight the importance of considering pollutant properties, experimental design, and sample size when measuring oxidative stress markers.
articles.title_zh:
氧化应激
污染物暴露后取决于
重点关注环节动物的实验设计和污染物特性：
荟萃分析
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 氧化应激的测量通常用于评估物种对污染物的一般亚致死应激反应。然而，氧化应激生物测定通常会产生看似不明确的结果，而导致这些差异的驱动因素在很大程度上尚不清楚。为了解决这一差距，我们对暴露于纳米和微塑料颗粒 (NMP) 和新烟碱类杀虫剂 (neonics) 两组污染物时的活性氧 (ROS) 生成、ROS 相关损伤产物、酶活性和基因表达水平进行了荟萃分析。基于从 45 项研究中提取的 2294 项 ROS 相关测量结果，我们表明测量的效果差异很大，测量的效果与零有很强的重叠。作为这种差异的可能驱动因素，我们确定了实验设计和污染物特性的多个参数。最后，我们进行了数据模拟和功率分析，以研究单个实验能够如何很好地检测氧化应激相关的影响。虽然大多数氧化应激标记物达到足够的功效（80％）来证明样本量 N < 1 的效果。如图 20 所示，来自小样本量（N < 5）的单项研究得出的结论可能会比之前假设的信息量少。我们的结果强调了在测量氧化应激标记物时考虑污染物特性、实验设计和样本量的重要性。

articles.title: Interpretable self-driving sputtering epitaxy reveals human-usable growth rules for β-Ga2O3 films
articles.abstract: Abstract Self-driving laboratories are powerful tools for navigating high-dimensional process spaces, yet Bayesian-optimization decision layers optimize black-box objective functions without distilling transferable process understanding. Here, we demonstrate a mathematically interpretable self-driving laboratory framework that transforms autonomous optimization data into human-executable growth rules. As a benchmark, we apply this framework to sputtering, addressing a challenge in sputtering epitaxy: realizing high-quality β -Ga 2 O 3 heteroepitaxy and single-crystalline β -Ga 2 O 3 homoepitaxy. By combining Bayesian optimization with automated optical evaluation of the Urbach energy as a sub-bandgap disorder metric, the self-driving system identifies heteroepitaxial conditions yielding an Urbach energy of 182 meV, below previously reported values for sputtered β -Ga 2 O 3 films. Importantly, the optimized growth window is transferable across substrates, realizing single-crystalline β -Ga 2 O 3 homoepitaxy, corroborated by scanning transmission electron microscopy. To convert closed-loop data into interpretable growth rules, we train a random forest surrogate and reveal that the growth landscape is described by additive contributions from four growth parameters, with a temperature–oxygen interaction. This structure suggests a human-executable strategy with sequential one-dimensional tuning followed by focused two-dimensional refinement, validated by human-executed re-optimization, yielding a reduced Urbach energy of 163 meV. This establishes an interpretable self-driving workflow that converts autonomous optimization data into validated, human-usable growth rules.
articles.title_zh: 可解释的自驱动溅射外延揭示了 β-Ga2O3 薄膜的人类可用生长规则
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 自动驾驶实验室是导航高维过程空间的强大工具，但贝叶斯优化决策层优化了黑盒目标函数，而无需提取可转移的过程理解。在这里，我们展示了一个数学上可解释的自动驾驶实验室框架，该框架将自主优化数据转换为人类可执行的增长规则。作为基准，我们将该框架应用于溅射，解决溅射外延中的挑战：实现高质量的β-Ga 2 O 3 异质外延和单晶β-Ga 2 O 3 同质外延。通过将贝叶斯优化与作为子带隙无序度量的 Urbach 能量的自动光学评估相结合，自动驱动系统识别出异质外延条件，产生 182 meV 的 Urbach 能量，低于之前报道的溅射 β -Ga 2 O 3 薄膜的值。重要的是，优化的生长窗口可以跨衬底转移，实现单晶β-Ga 2 O 3 同质外延，并通过扫描透射电子显微镜证实。为了将闭环数据转换为可解释的生长规则，我们训练了一个随机森林代理，并揭示了生长景观是由四个生长参数的附加贡献以及温度-氧气相互作用来描述的。这种结构提出了一种人类可执行的策略，先进行顺序一维调整，然后进行集中的二维细化，并通过人类执行的重新优化进行验证，从而将乌尔巴赫能量降低至 163 meV。这建立了一个可解释的自动驾驶工作流程，将自主优化数据转换为经过验证的、人类可用的增长规则。

articles.title: A microphysiological system HHT-on-a-chip platform recapitulates patient vascular lesions
articles.abstract: Abstract Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia (HHT) is a rare congenital disease in which fragile vascular malformations (VM) focally develop in multiple organs. There are few treatment options and no cure. HHT patients inherit loss-of-function mutations affecting Alk1-Eng signaling; however, why this manifests as VMs remains poorly understood. Here we have developed a fully human cell-based microphysiological system of perfused vasculature in which inducible shRNA controls endogenous Alk1 in primary endothelial cells (EC). Resulting VMs develop over several days, recapitulate patient VM appearance, and require only a subpopulation of Alk1-deficient EC to trigger lesions. Single-cell transcriptomics suggests microvessel pruning and regression contribute to VM, while loss of PDGFB implicates mural cell recruitment. Finally, pharmacological VEGF/VEGFR inhibition blocks lesion formation. In summary, we have developed an HHT-on-a-chip model that faithfully reproduces HHT patient lesions and that can be used to better understand HHT disease biology and identify potential new HHT drugs.
articles.title_zh: 微生理系统 HHT 芯片平台再现患者血管病变
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 遗传性出血性毛细血管扩张症（HHT）是一种罕见的先天性疾病，其中多个器官局灶性出现脆弱的血管畸形（VM）。治疗选择很少，而且无法治愈。 HHT 患者遗传了影响 Alk1-Eng 信号传导的功能丧失突变；然而，为什么这表现为虚拟机仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们开发了一种完全基于人类细胞的灌注脉管系统微生理系统，其中诱导型 shRNA 控制原代内皮细胞 (EC) 中的内源性 Alk1。由此产生的 VM 会在几天内形成，重现患者 VM 的外观，并且仅需要 Alk1 缺陷的 EC 亚群即可触发病变。单细胞转录组学表明微血管修剪和退化有助于 VM，而 PDGFB 的丢失则意味着壁细胞的募集。最后，药理学 VEGF/VEGFR 抑制可阻止病变形成。总之，我们开发了一种 HHT 芯片模型，可以忠实地再现 HHT 患者病变，可用于更好地了解 HHT 疾病生物学并识别潜在的新 HHT 药物。

articles.title: Drops in confidence precede symptoms of obsessive-compulsive disorder
articles.abstract: Abstract Mental health symptoms, like those in obsessive-compulsive disorder, show pronounced fluctuations over time. However, little is known about the underlying factors driving these fluctuations. Whilst theoretical accounts propose that cognitive processes drive symptom variability, cross-sectional work is unable to effectively probe these mechanisms. Based on prevailing notions of doubt and underconfidence being cognitive hallmarks of the disorder, we investigate whether metacognitive processes correspond to obsessive-compulsive disorder symptoms. We employ a smartphone-based momentary assessment design wherein participants with obsessive-compulsive disorder ( N = 137) log instances of experiencing symptoms across 2-weeks. Participants also complete daily scheduled assessments and play a perceptual metacognitive task every two days. Our results reveal that metacognition is associated with obsessive-compulsive symptoms. Concretely, we find directional effects whereby reductions in both self-confidence and task-based metacognition precede occurrences of obsessive-compulsive symptom logs, but not vice versa. Moreover, confidence during perceptual decision-making is significantly related to self-reported confidence on a moment-to-moment basis, indicating that distinct metacognitive modalities may be interrelated. Results remain robust in the face of several sensitivity analyses targeting possible imbalances and missingness in the data. Thus, our micro-longitudinal study design provides evidence for cognitive distortions (both self-reported and task-based) preceding symptom escalations, signifying the potential for designing just-in-time interventions.
articles.title_zh: 强迫症症状出现之前信心下降
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 心理健康症状，就像强迫症的症状一样，随着时间的推移表现出明显的波动。然而，人们对驱动这些波动的潜在因素知之甚少。虽然理论解释表明认知过程驱动症状变异，但横断面工作无法有效地探讨这些机制。基于普遍存在的怀疑和不自信是该疾病的认知标志的观念，我们研究元认知过程是否与强迫症症状相对应。我们采用基于智能手机的瞬时评估设计，其中强迫症参与者（N = 137）记录两周内经历症状的实例。参与者还完成每日预定的评估，并每两天进行一次感知元认知任务。我们的研究结果表明，元认知与强迫症状有关。具体来说，我们发现了方向性效应，即自信心和基于任务的元认知的降低先于强迫症状日志的出现，但反之则不然。此外，感知决策过程中的信心与每时每刻的自我报告信心显着相关，这表明不同的元认知模式可能是相互关联的。面对针对数据中可能存在的不平衡和缺失的多项敏感性分析，结果仍然稳健。因此，我们的微观纵向研究设计为症状升级之前的认知扭曲（包括自我报告的和基于任务的）提供了证据，这表明设计及时干预措施的潜力。

articles.title: Modeling reptile virus infection in vitro using Python regius airway organoids
articles.abstract: Abstract Zoonoses pose substantial global health risks, highlighting the need to better understand animal-to-human transmission. Reptiles are increasingly recognized as hosts of diverse pathogens, including numerous viruses, yet the diversity and prevalence of reptile pathogens, as well as their potential risk to humans, remain poorly understood. Here, we establish and characterize airway organoids derived from Python regius , providing an in vitro model to study reptile airway infection. Through de novo assembly of a Python regius reference genome, we characterize airway organoids at single-cell resolution, which suggests the presence of diverse cell populations including ionocytes, ciliated, secretory, goblet, endocrine, tuft, and basal cells. The organoids support productive infection with Ball Python Nidovirus (BPNV) and mount a robust epithelial antiviral response through the induction of interferon-stimulated genes, cytokines, and genes involved in chemical defense. As a proof-of-concept, treating organoids with antiviral drugs during infection reduces BPNV levels, highlighting the model’s utility for drug testing. By providing a reductionist system of the serpentes airway, these organoids constitute a physiologically relevant in vitro model to study reptile viruses and host–pathogen interactions in their native host.
articles.title_zh: 使用 Python regius 气道类器官对爬行动物病毒感染进行体外建模
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 人畜共患疾病对全球健康构成巨大风险，凸显了更好地了解动物向人类传播的必要性。人们越来越多地认识到爬行动物是多种病原体（包括多种病毒）的宿主，但人们对爬行动物病原体的多样性和流行率以及它们对人类的潜在风险仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们建立并表征了源自 Python regius 的气道类器官，为研究爬行动物气道感染提供了体外模型。通过 Python regius 参考基因组的从头组装，我们以单细胞分辨率表征了气道类器官，这表明存在不同的细胞群，包括离子细胞、纤毛细胞、分泌细胞、杯状细胞、内分泌细胞、簇状细胞和基底细胞。这些类器官支持球蟒 Nidovirus (BPNV) 的有效感染，并通过诱导干扰素刺激的基因、细胞因子和参与化学防御的基因来产生强大的上皮抗病毒反应。作为概念验证，在感染期间用抗病毒药物治疗类器官可降低 BPNV 水平，凸显了该模型在药物测试中的实用性。通过提供蛇类气道的还原论系统，这些类器官构成了生理相关的体外模型，用于研究爬行动物病毒及其天然宿主中的宿主-病原体相互作用。

articles.title:
Oxygen-Vacancies-Bridged
Cu2O/Cu Heterojunction
Enables Closed-Loop Electron Cycling for Bidirectional Peracetic Acid
Activation in Fenton-like Reactions
articles.abstract: Abstract Integrating the strong oxidative capacity of radicals with the high selectivity of nonradicals is crucial for efficient pollutant degradation under complex aqueous conditions. However, conventional peroxide activation relies on unidirectional electron utilization, where a single oxidant molecule typically generates only one reactive species, thereby limiting oxidant utilization and electron recycling. Herein, we employ oxygen vacancies (Vo) to bridge asymmetric electronic sites at the Cu2O/Cu heterojunction, achieving bidirectional activation of a single peracetic acid (PAA) within a “closed-loop electron cycle” to simultaneously generate •OH and nonradical active species (NRS). Vo-induced electron delocalization forms continuous electronic levels that facilitate Cu2O→Cu electron transfer, leading to electron enrichment at Cu sites and depletion at Cu2O sites. This electronic asymmetry, coupled with the unoccupied orbitals inherent to Vo, enables a thermodynamically favorable dual-coordination (Cu–(C═Oα) and Cu2O–(Oβ–Oγ), Eads = −3.74 vs −0.79 eV) of a single PAA (CH3–C(Oα)–Oβ–Oγ–H) with Vo–Cu2O/Cu. Driven by the electron-inductive effect, electrons are transferred from Cu to Oβ–Oγ via C═Oα, triggering Oβ–Oγ homolysis to generate •OH and a metastable NRS. The latter extracts electrons from organics via Cu2O to initiate the direct electron-transfer pathway (ETP, ∼46.90%, ΔE = −1.314 eV), thereby achieving a “closed-loop electron cycle”. Unlike conventional unidirectional catalytic pathways, bidirectional activation within a single PAA molecule boosts synchronous enhancement in oxidation-mineralization synergy (∼33-fold increase in k2,O and ∼1.5-fold increase in TOC removal), PAA utilization efficiency (∼1.5-fold increase), and superior resistance to water matrix interference. This previously unrecognized oxidant activation mechanism offers new insights into coupling radical and nonradical pathways via interfacial electron-flow regulation for efficient and energy-saving water remediation.
articles.title_zh:
氧空位桥
Cu2O/Cu异质结
实现双向过乙酸的闭环电子循环
类芬顿反应中的活化
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 将自由基的强氧化能力与非自由基的高选择性相结合对于复杂水条件下污染物的高效降解至关重要。然而，传统的过氧化物活化依赖于单向电子利用，其中单个氧化剂分子通常仅产生一种活性物质，从而限制了氧化剂利用和电子回收。在此，我们利用氧空位（Vo）桥接Cu2O/Cu异质结上的不对称电子位点，实现“闭环电子循环”内单个过乙酸（PAA）的双向激活，同时生成·OH和非自由基活性物质（NRS）。 Vo诱导的电子离域形成连续的电子能级，促进Cu2O→Cu电子转移，导致Cu位点的电子富集和Cu2O位点的耗尽。这种电子不对称性与 Vo 固有的未占据轨道相结合，使得单个 PAA (CH3–C(Oα)–Oβ–Oγ–H) 与 Vo–Cu2O/Cu 形成热力学上有利的双配位（Cu–(C=Oα) 和 Cu2O–(Oβ–Oγ)，Eads = -3.74 vs -0.79 eV）。在电子感应效应的驱动下，电子通过C=Oα从Cu转移到Oβ–Oγ，引发Oβ–Oγ均裂生成·OH和亚稳态NRS。后者通过 Cu2O 从有机物中提取电子，启动直接电子转移途径（ETP，∼46.90%，ΔE = -1.314 eV），从而实现“闭环电子循环”。与传统的单向催化途径不同，单个 PAA 分子内的双向激活可同步增强氧化-矿化协同作用（k2,O 增加约 33 倍，TOC 去除增加约 1.5 倍）、PAA 利用率（增加约 1.5 倍）和卓越的抗水基质干扰能力。这种以前未被认识的氧化剂活化机制为通过界面电子流调节耦合自由基和非自由基途径提供了新的见解，以实现高效节能的水修复。

articles.title:
Bridging Human and
Environmental Radiological Protection
with the Ecosystem Services Approach: A Case Study with Clade Anthophila
(Bees)
articles.abstract: Abstract Ecosystem services, the benefits people derive from nature, provides a conceptual structure by which to explicitly characterize and protect the coupled human–nature relationships that are central to human well-being, the integrity of ecosystems, and sustainable development. We suggest the ecosystem services concept may complement and broaden the International Commission on Radiological Protection’s currently established framework of radiological protection (RP) through intentional reflection on the interconnection between people and their environment. As operationalization of an ecosystem services approach is a notable challenge for implementation, we discuss Anthophila (bees) as a model clade for demonstrating how the ecosystem services approach may contribute to the integrated protection of people and the environment across geographies, cultures, and exposure scenarios. Assessing the impacts of radiological contamination and associated decision-making on ecosystem services has the potential to bridge human and environmental RP through adoption of a sustainable development mindset, enhanced stakeholder engagement, and improved decision-making. We provide a framework to describe how a conceptual model to combine the ecosystem services approach with RP could be helpful in supporting holistic and integrated decision-making in certain situations and demonstrate its application to a hypothetical existing exposure situation using bees as a model clade of species.
articles.title_zh:
架起人与人之间的桥梁
环境放射防护
生态系统服务方法：以 Clade Anthophila 为例
（蜜蜂）
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 生态系统服务是人类从自然中获得的利益，它提供了一个概念结构，通过该结构可以明确描述和保护对人类福祉、生态系统完整性和可持续发展至关重要的人与自然耦合关系。我们建议，通过有意反思人与环境之间的相互关系，生态系统服务概念可以补充和扩大国际放射防护委员会目前建立的放射防护（RP）框架。由于生态系统服务方法的可操作性是实施的一个显着挑战，我们将 Anthophila（蜜蜂）作为一个模型分支来讨论生态系统服务方法如何有助于跨地域、文化和暴露场景的人类和环境的综合保护。评估放射性污染和相关决策对生态系统服务的影响有可能通过采用可持续发展思维、增强利益相关者的参与和改进决策来弥合人类和环境的RP。我们提供了一个框架来描述将生态系统服务方法与 RP 相结合的概念模型如何有助于支持某些情况下的整体和综合决策，并展示其在使用蜜蜂作为物种模型进化枝的假设的现有暴露情况中的应用。

articles.title:
Transport
and Attenuation of Human Viruses in Groundwater:
Assessment of Adsorption-Induced Interfacial Inactivation and Evidence
of Aggregation
articles.abstract: Abstract Virus transport in groundwater is a key pathway contributing to waterborne disease outbreaks and poses significant risks to public health. However, the mechanisms governing virus transport and attenuation remain poorly understood. Here, using the human enteric virus Coxsackievirus (CV-A16), we coupled experiments with a dual-marker approach (TCID50 and RT-qPCR) and a stepwise modeling strategy to quantify virus inactivation, interfacial inactivation, and adsorption during virus transport and attenuation in heterogeneous sediments. Static batch experiments revealed markedly slower CV-A16 inactivation in the aqueous phase, requiring 106–191 days to achieve a 90% loss of infectivity, compared with about 12 days in saturated sediments. Column experiments indicated that kinetic adsorption–desorption was the dominant attenuation mechanism, while surface-associated interfacial inactivation represented an additional important pathway that increased with virus adsorption, reflecting a coupled adsorption-inactivation process. Further analysis showed that inactivation rate constants ranged from 0.002 to 0.004 min–1 from coarse sand to silt, suggesting enhanced virus-solid interface reactivity in finer sediments. Furthermore, bimodal particle-size distributions from laser particle sizing and TEM observations of virus clusters indicate the formation of aggregates during transport, while zeta potential variations suggest that this process most likely occurs during the early to intermediate stages of transport. By evaluating the interplay between physical retention and biological inactivation, this study provides a mechanistic framework to improve the prediction of virus transport and the accuracy of pathogen-related health risk assessments in subsurface environments.
articles.title_zh:
交通
和地下水中人类病毒的减毒：
吸附引起的界面失活的评估和证据
聚合的
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 地下水中的病毒传播是导致水传播疾病爆发的关键途径，并对公众健康构成重大风险。然而，人们对病毒运输和减毒的机制仍知之甚少。在这里，我们使用人类肠道病毒柯萨奇病毒（CV-A16），将实验与双标记方法（TCID50和RT-qPCR）和逐步建模策略结合起来，以量化病毒在异质沉积物中运输和减毒过程中的病毒失活、界面失活和吸附。静态批量实验表明，CV-A16 在水相中的灭活速度明显较慢，需要 106-191 天才能实现感染性损失 90%，而在饱和沉积物中则需要约 12 天。柱实验表明，动力学吸附-解吸是主要的衰减机制，而表面相关的界面失活代表了随着病毒吸附而增加的另一个重要途径，反映了吸附-失活的耦合过程。进一步分析表明，从粗砂到淤泥，灭活速率常数范围为 0.002 至 0.004 min-1，这表明较细沉积物中的病毒-固体界面反应性增强。此外，激光粒度测定和病毒簇 TEM 观察得出的双峰粒度分布表明在运输过程中形成了聚集体，而 zeta 电位变化表明该过程最有可能发生在运输的早期到中期阶段。通过评估物理滞留和生物灭活之间的相互作用，本研究提供了一个机制框架，以提高地下环境中病毒传播的预测和病原体相关健康风险评估的准确性。

articles.title:
Intraspecies Variation
of Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl
Substances Bioaccumulation in a Coastal Marine Organism Near a Megacity
articles.abstract: Abstract Intraspecies variation in pollutant bioaccumulation has received limited attention in field studies, which could cause bias for ecological and health risk assessment. In this study, 40 per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) and stable carbon and nitrogen isotope were analyzed in 43 individuals of Cynoglossus trigrammus collected from the coastal area of Shenzhen City, China, to explore the intraspecies variation in PFAS bioaccumulation. Total PFAS (Σ40PFAS) concentrations ranged from 40.0 to 192 ng/g, ww, and increased significantly with body length (p < 0.001). Positive relationships (p < 0.01) were observed for perfluorooctanesulfonate (PFOS), perfluorodecanoic acid (PFDA), perfluoropentanesulfonic acid (PFPeS), and perfluorohexanesulfonic acid (PFHxS), whereas negative relationships (p < 0.05) were observed for perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA), N-methyl perfluorooctanesulfonamidoacetic acid (N-MeFOSE), and 11-Chloroeicosafluoro-3-oxaundecane-1-sulfonic acid (11Cl-PF3OUdS) with body length. Muscle-derived trophic levels also showed significant relationships but were different and weaker than those of body length. Quantile regression showed stronger size effects at high quantiles of whole-fish burden (τ = 0.90 and 0.95), and size-selective feeding (length ≥75th percentile) shifted dose distributions toward higher values. These results suggest that body length is an important indicator to identify the intraspecies PFAS heterogeneity and that size-selective processes might increase upper percentiles exposure and risks.
articles.title_zh:
种内变异
全氟烷基和多氟烷基
大城市附近沿海海洋生物中的物质生物累积
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 污染物生物累积的种内变化在实地研究中受到的关注有限，这可能会导致生态和健康风险评估的偏差。本研究对采自中国深圳市沿海地区的 43 只食蟹猴个体中的 40 种全氟烷基物质和多氟烷基物质 (PFAS) 以及稳定碳和氮同位素进行了分析，以探讨 PFAS 生物累积的种内变化。总 PFAS (Σ40PFAS) 浓度范围为 40.0 至 192 ng/g, ww，并随着体长显着增加 (p < 0.001)。全氟辛烷磺酸 (PFOS)、全氟癸酸 (PFDA)、全氟戊烷磺酸 (PFPeS) 和全氟己烷磺酸 (PFHxS) 呈正相关 (p < 0.01)，而全氟辛酸 (PFOA)、N-甲基全氟辛烷磺酰胺乙酸呈负相关 (p < 0.05) (N-MeFOSE) 和 11-氯二十一氟-3-氧十一烷-1-磺酸 (11Cl-PF3OUdS) 的体长。肌肉来源的营养水平也显示出显着的关系，但与身体长度的关系不同且较弱。分位数回归显示，在全鱼负荷的高分位数（τ = 0.90 和 0.95）下，尺寸效应更强，并且尺寸选择性喂养（长度≥75%）将剂量分布转向更高的值。这些结果表明，体长是识别种内 PFAS 异质性的重要指标，并且体型选择过程可能会增加上百分位数的暴露和风险。

articles.title:
Facilitation-Dominated
Motifs Characterize Cross-Domain
Microbial Networks in Co-Occurring Water and Soil Habitats
articles.abstract: Abstract Microorganisms form complex association networks supporting diverse functions from organic matter decomposition to water quality. However, the prevalence of different network structures (i.e., motifs) and their associations with biodiversity across ecosystems remain poorly understood. We surveyed paired water and soil samples from 20 relatively pristine Tibetan Plateau wetlands, spanning broad climatic and physicochemical gradients. Facilitation-dominated motifs were prevalent in both habitats and positively associated with phylogenetic diversity and species richness across domains; greater positive association prevalence among archaea, bacteria, and eukaryotes likewise correlated with greater biodiversity. These patterns were robust to alternative edge-retention thresholds, abundance table null models, and networks reconstructed from centered log-ratio-transformed or presence/absence data. Facilitation-dominated motifs were most consistently associated with network size- and centralization-related properties, whereas their associations with cohesion- and stability-related properties were more habitat-dependent and were clearer in soil than in water. The cycle facilitation motif, with all three pairwise associations positive, showed the most consistent associations with biodiversity and network properties. Structural equation modeling suggested links between environmental factors and biodiversity through paths involving the motif overrepresentation. Overall, facilitation-dominated co-occurrence structures were consistently associated with biodiversity in water and soil habitats, highlighting the microbial association structure as a useful framework for interpreting wetland biodiversity patterns.
articles.title_zh:
以便利为主
主题表征跨领域
水和土壤共存生境中的微生物网络
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 微生物形成复杂的关联网络，支持从有机物分解到水质的多种功能。然而，不同网络结构（即主题）的普遍性及其与跨生态系统生物多样性的关联仍然知之甚少。我们调查了来自 20 个相对原始的青藏高原湿地的配对水和土壤样本，涵盖了广泛的气候和物理化学梯度。促进主导的主题在这两个栖息地中都很普遍，并且与跨领域的系统发育多样性和物种丰富度呈正相关；古细菌、细菌和真核生物之间更大的正相关流行率同样与更大的生物多样性相关。这些模式对于替代边缘保留阈值、丰度表空模型以及从中心对数比转换或存在/不存在数据重建的网络来说是稳健的。促进主导的主题与网络规模和集中度相关的特性最为一致，而它们与内聚力和稳定性相关特性的关联则更多地依赖于栖息地，并且在土壤中比在水中更清晰。循环促进主题，所有三个成对关联均为正，显示出与生物多样性和网络特性最一致的关联。结构方程模型通过涉及主题过度表达的路径表明环境因素与生物多样性之间的联系。总体而言，促进主导的共现结构始终与水和土壤栖息地的生物多样性相关，强调微生物关联结构是解释湿地生物多样性模式的有用框架。

articles.title:
Zebrafish Serotonin
Transporter Inhibition Enables
Identification of Neuroactive Chemicals: Structural Insights into
Interspecies Differences
articles.abstract: Abstract Antidepressants are widely detected in aquatic environments and can affect fish behavior through inhibition of the serotonin transporter (SERT). Notably, zebrafish SERT (zSERT) exhibits greater sensitivity to antidepressants than human SERT (hSERT), suggesting species-specific differences in transporter structures. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying this differential inhibition remain elusive, and prioritized antidepressants alone cannot fully explain the zSERT-mediated activity observed in the environmental samples. Herein, molecular simulation, computational screening, and experimental validation were adopted to identify environmental chemicals with potential activity toward zSERT. The binding affinity of 27 antidepressants for hSERT and zSERT was predicted by Boltz-2. The antidepressant with the largest interspecies difference was selected as a representative case, and the key amino acid residues involved in binding were characterized by using molecular dynamics simulations performed for at least 100 ns. The molecular simulation-optimized zSERT structure was then applied in structure-based virtual screening to identify potentially toxic compounds from a chemical library comprising high-risk chemicals from Europe and China. Fourteen of the 15 top-ranked candidates were found to inhibit zSERT in an in vitro assay. This integrative approach provides a mechanistically informed framework for identifying previously unrecognized zSERT-acting chemicals and improving hazard identification and cross-species risk assessments in aquatic environments.
articles.title_zh:
斑马鱼血清素
转运蛋白抑制使
神经活性化学物质的鉴定：结构洞察
种间差异
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 抗抑郁药在水生环境中广泛存在，可通过抑制血清素转运蛋白 (SERT) 影响鱼类行为。值得注意的是，斑马鱼 SERT (zSERT) 比人类 SERT (hSERT) 对抗抑郁药表现出更高的敏感性，这表明转运蛋白结构存在物种特异性差异。然而，这种差异抑制背后的分子机制仍然难以捉摸，并且单独优先的抗抑郁药无法完全解释在环境样本中观察到的 zSERT 介导的活性。在此，采用分子模拟、计算筛选和实验验证来识别对 zSERT 具有潜在活性的环境化学物质。 Boltz-2 预测了 27 种抗抑郁药对 hSERT 和 zSERT 的结合亲和力。选择种间差异最大的抗抑郁药作为代表案例，并通过至少100 ns的分子动力学模拟来表征参与结合的关键氨基酸残基。然后将分子模拟优化的 zSERT 结构应用于基于结构的虚拟筛选，以从包含来自欧洲和中国的高风险化学品的化学库中识别潜在有毒化合物。在体外测定中，发现 15 个排名靠前的候选药物中有 14 个能够抑制 zSERT。这种综合方法提供了一个机械化的框架，用于识别以前未被识别的 zSERT 作用化学品，并改进水生环境中的危害识别和跨物种风险评估。

articles.title:
Carbonyl Index Variability
and Trends in Marine Meso-Microplastics:
Implications of Instrumental Effects and Spectral Preprocessing
articles.abstract: Abstract This study addresses the critical need to understand variability in the carbonyl index (CI) of marine plastics to effectively assess their environmental fate. Standardization is essential to ensure data interoperability and comparability across different research laboratories. We evaluated the effect of spectral preprocessing on the comparability of four carbonyl indices derived from analyses of marine meso- and microplastics across three ATR-FTIR instruments. The fillpeaks baseline spectral preprocessing correction yielded the highest consistency and interlaboratory correlation, thus supporting its adoption as a standard for environmental CI determination. Moreover, when used with the CI-SAUB index, defined as the ratio of the carbonyl peak area to the methylene peak area, instrumental differences are effectively smoothed out. We also demonstrated that index-specific CI values derived from spectra processed differently are not directly comparable, further underscoring the need for harmonized protocols. Our analysis supports the use of the CI as a reliable proxy for surface oxidation resulting from weathering mechanisms. To enhance reproducibility in future research, we provide a cross-validated, open-access spectral library of weathered plastics, along with a reference database for estimating the CI of weathered particles. Our results emphasize the importance of standardized approaches for improving the reliability and reproducibility of plastic pollution research and monitoring.
articles.title_zh:
羰基指数变异性
海洋细观微塑料的发展趋势：
仪器效应和光谱预处理的意义
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 这项研究解决了了解海洋塑料羰基指数 (CI) 变化的迫切需要，以有效评估其环境命运。标准化对于确保不同研究实验室之间的数据互操作性和可比性至关重要。我们评估了光谱预处理对四个羰基指数可比性的影响，这四个羰基指数是通过三台 ATR-FTIR 仪器对海洋细观塑料和微塑料进行分析得出的。 fillpeaks 基线光谱预处理校正产生了最高的一致性和实验室间相关性，从而支持其采用作为环境 CI 测定的标准。此外，当与 CI-SAUB 指数（定义为羰基峰面积与亚甲基峰面积之比）一起使用时，可以有效消除仪器差异。我们还证明，从不同处理的光谱中得出的特定指数 CI 值不能直接比较，这进一步强调了协调协议的必要性。我们的分析支持使用 CI 作为风化机制导致的表面氧化的可靠指标。为了提高未来研究的可重复性，我们提供了一个经过交叉验证、开放获取的风化塑料光谱库，以及用于估计风化颗粒 CI 的参考数据库。我们的结果强调了标准化方法对于提高塑料污染研究和监测的可靠性和可重复性的重要性。

articles.title:
Monovalent
Ion Selectivity
Incomparability of Graphene
Oxide Membrane in Different Separation Systems: A Microscopic Understanding
articles.abstract: Abstract Precise monovalent ion sieving is essential for water treatment and resource recovery. However, ion selectivity reported from diffusion-based and electro-driven membrane processes is often inconsistent and difficult to reconcile due to unclear mechanistic understanding. Herein, combining experiments with molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, we reveal divergent microscopic mechanisms governing monovalent ion selectivity in graphene oxide (GO) nanochannels under different driving forces. Under concentration gradient-driven diffusion, ion selectivity is predominantly regulated by hydration-mediated effects (i.e., partial ion dehydration and dehydration-induced ion–membrane interactions) and cation–anion interaction. Specifically, in simulated defect-free GO nanochannel, Li+, with higher hydration energy and charge density than Na+, possesses a more intact hydration shell and stronger cation–anion interaction, which limit partitioning but reduce transport resistance, resulting in a Li+/Na+ selectivity of 3.3. Conversely, under electric field-driven electromigration, a reversed selectivity (Li+/Na+ = 0.4) occurs due to enhanced cation–anion associations, where stronger Li+–Cl– pairing suppresses both cation partitioning and mobility, generating ion association-dominated selectivity. These results demonstrate that ion selectivity is not an intrinsic membrane property but is strongly governed by the driving-force-dependent transport mechanism. This study resolves the long-standing incomparability in ion selectivity across different separation systems and provides mechanistic guidance for designing next-generation membranes with tailored ion selectivity.
articles.title_zh:
单价
离子选择性
石墨烯无可比拟
不同分离系统中的氧化物膜：微观理解
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 精确的单价离子筛分对于水处理和资源回收至关重要。然而，由于对机理的理解不明确，基于扩散和电驱动的膜过程报告的离子选择性通常不一致并且难以协调。在此，结合实验与分子动力学（MD）模拟，我们揭示了在不同驱动力下控制氧化石墨烯（GO）纳米通道中单价离子选择性的不同微观机制。在浓度梯度驱动的扩散下，离子选择性主要受水合介导效应（即部分离子脱水和脱水诱导的离子膜相互作用）和阳离子阴离子相互作用的调节。具体来说，在模拟的无缺陷GO纳米通道中，Li+比Na+具有更高的水合能和电荷密度，拥有更完整的水合壳和更强的阳离子-阴离子相互作用，这限制了分配但降低了传输阻力，导致Li+/Na+选择性为3.3。相反，在电场驱动的电迁移下，由于阳离子-阴离子缔合增强，出现反向选择性（Li+/Na+ = 0.4），其中更强的Li+-Cl-配对抑制阳离子分配和迁移率，产生离子缔合主导的选择性。这些结果表明，离子选择性不是固有的膜特性，而是受到驱动力依赖的传输机制的强烈控制。这项研究解决了不同分离系统之间离子选择性长期存在的不可比性，并为设计具有定制离子选择性的下一代膜提供了机械指导。

articles.title:
Safeguarding Cost-Effective
and Risk-Mitigated Chemical
Decarbonization by Diversified Energy Supply
articles.abstract: Abstract Wind and solar power are widely regarded as the primary energy sources for chemical decarbonization, yet their spatial mismatch with production hubs poses inherent challenges. Locally available hydropower, nuclear power, and biomass offer promising alternatives. Using a spatially explicit model with endogenous optimization of industrial spatial configuration, we show that diversified energy supply safeguards cost-effective and risk-mitigated chemical decarbonization in China, compared to the prevailing wind–solar-dominated strategies. By 2060, the annualized cost of chemical sector is reduced by 218 billion CNY (0.22% of China’s 2020 GDP), and the marginal abatement cost declines from 3160 to 1401 CNY/t, making net-zero emissions more economically feasible. Deployment requirements for critical-metal-intensive electrolyzers and energy storage technologies decline by 46.5% and 63.7%, respectively, and the still-immature direct air capture with utilization becomes largely unnecessary. Moreover, the potential stranded coal-based chemical capacity declines from 16.9 GW to 1.55 GW, and the chemical-sector contractions in Henan, Guizhou, and Chongqing are avoided, primarily through biomass-based methanol expansion. We caution against overly optimistic wind–solar-dominated strategies and advocate regionally tailored transitions.
articles.title_zh:
保障成本效益
和降低风险的化学品
多元化能源供应脱碳
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 风能和太阳能被广泛认为是化学脱碳的主要能源，但它们与生产中心的空间不匹配带来了固有的挑战。当地可用的水电、核电和生物质能提供了有前景的替代方案。使用具有产业空间配置内生优化的空间显式模型，我们表明，与现行的风能-太阳能主导战略相比，多元化的能源供应保障了中国化学脱碳的成本效益和风险降低。到2060年，化工行业年化成本降低2180亿元人民币（占中国2020年GDP的0.22%），边际减排成本从3160元/吨下降到1401元/吨，净零排放在经济上更加可行。关键金属密集型电解槽和储能技术的部署要求分别下降了46.5%和63.7%，而尚不成熟的直接空气捕获和利用在很大程度上变得没有必要。此外，潜在搁浅的煤化工产能从16.9吉瓦下降至1.55吉瓦，主要通过生物质甲醇扩张避免了河南、贵州和重庆的化工行业收缩。我们警告不要过于乐观的风能-太阳能主导战略，并提倡针对区域进行量身定制的转型。

articles.title: Uncovering tert -Butylphenols as New Precursors of 2,4,6-Trichlorophenol in Chlorinated Drinking Water
articles.abstract: Abstract 2,4,6-Trichlorophenol is a well-known carcinogen, aromatic disinfection byproduct (DBP), and anthropogenic contaminant in drinking water, with a high detection frequency and concentration. Natural organic matter (NOM) is considered as its key precursor; however, the formation potential of NOM to 2,4,6-trichlorophenol during chlorination does not explain the μg/L levels observed in disinfected drinking water. In this study, concentrations of 2,4,6-trichlorophenol in drinking water from South Carolina were determined, and important new tert-butylphenol precursors were identified using nontarget and suspect screening analysis with gas chromatography (GC)-mass spectrometry (MS). Concentrations of 2,4,6-trichlorophenol in 12 chlorinated and chloraminated drinking water samples ranged from 9 to 14,966 ng/L (mean: 4805 ng/L), higher than 11 other classes of aromatic DBPs and 4 classes of aliphatic DBPs. During chlorination, yields of 2,4,6-trichlorophenol from Suwannee River NOM were 22 ng/mg-total organic carbon (TOC). In contrast, 2-tert-butylphenol, 4-tert-butylphenol, 2,4-di-tert-butylphenol, and 2,6-di-tert-butylphenol, found up to 41,037 ng/L in river water as industrial contaminants, showed yields of 737, 711, 1261, and 2939 ng/mg-TOC, respectively. tert-Butylphenols in source water contributed ∼3% of 2,4,6-trichlorophenol in the studied chlorinated river waters. Formation mechanisms were proposed. This study provides insight into uncovering additional unknown precursors of chlorophenols.
articles.title_zh: 揭秘 叔 - 丁基苯酚作为新产品 氯化饮用水中 2,4,6-三氯苯酚的前体
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 2,4,6-三氯苯酚是众所周知的致癌物、芳香族消毒副产物（DBP）和饮用水中的人为污染物，检测频率和浓度较高。天然有机质（NOM）被认为是其关键前体；然而，氯化过程中 NOM 形成 2,4,6-三氯苯酚的可能性并不能解释消毒饮用水中观察到的 μg/L 水平。在这项研究中，测定了南卡罗来纳州饮用水中 2,4,6-三氯苯酚的浓度，并通过气相色谱 (GC)-质谱 (MS) 进行非目标和可疑筛选分析，鉴定了重要的新型叔丁基苯酚前体。 12 个氯化和氯胺化饮用水样品中 2,4,6-三氯苯酚的浓度范围为 9 至 14,966 ng/L（平均值：4805 ng/L），高于其他 11 类芳香族 DBP 和 4 类脂肪族 DBP。在氯化过程中，Suwannee River NOM 中 2,4,6-三氯苯酚的产量为 22 ng/mg 总有机碳 (TOC)。相比之下，河水中工业污染物 2-叔丁基苯酚、4-叔丁基苯酚、2,4-二叔丁基苯酚和 2,6-二叔丁基苯酚的含量高达 41,037 ng/L，其 TOC 产量分别为 737、711、1261 和 2939 ng/mg-TOC。在所研究的氯化河水中，源水中的叔丁基苯酚占 2,4,6-三氯苯酚的 3%。提出了形成机制。这项研究为揭示其他未知的氯酚前体提供了见解。

articles.title:
Vector-Controlled
*CO Transport Drives Efficient Urea
Electrosynthesis
articles.abstract: Abstract Electrocatalytic coupling of carbon dioxide and nitrate provides a sustainable route for urea synthesis. However, constrained by the ambiguous intermediate reaction pathways, such systems typically require a highly negative potential (≤ −0.5 V vs RHE) to achieve high urea yields. This inevitably results in prohibitive electricity expenses, which account for approximately 48% of the total expenditure for urea electrosynthesis and represent a major bottleneck hindering this promising approach. Herein, a vector-controlled *CO intermediate transport strategy is reported to direct the coupling pathway. This strategy realized an anodic potential shift of 300 mV and a remarkable urea yield of 2927 μg h–1 cm–2 at −0.2 V (vs RHE), outperforming most reported electrocatalysts. Techno-economic analysis reveals that this process reduces energy consumption and cuts electricity costs by over 25%. This unidirectional *CO transport is achieved via a precisely engineered CuAg interface, where a tailored asymmetric local electronic environment with a d-band center difference of 1.64 eV induces a *CO adsorption energy difference of 0.8 eV. This enables continuous *CO desorption from weakly adsorbing Ag sites and unidirectional transport to strongly adsorbing Cu sites, thus facilitating the critical *NOCO formation. This work establishes a promising pathway for energy-saving urea synthesis.
articles.title_zh:
矢量控制
*二氧化碳运输推动高效尿素
电合成
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 二氧化碳和硝酸盐的电催化偶联为尿素合成提供了一条可持续的途径。然而，受不明确的中间反应途径的限制，此类系统通常需要高负电势（≤ -0.5 V vs RHE）才能实现高尿素产率。这不可避免地导致高昂的电力费用，约占尿素电合成总支出的 48%，是阻碍这一有希望的方法的主要瓶颈。在此，报道了一种矢量控制的 *CO 中间运输策略来指导耦合途径。该策略在-0.2 V（相对于 RHE）下实现了 300 mV 的阳极电位变化和 2927 μg h–1 cm–2 的显着尿素产量，优于大多数报道的电催化剂。技术经济分析表明，这一过程可减少能源消耗，并将电力成本降低 25% 以上。这种单向 *CO 传输是通过精确设计的 CuAg 界面实现的，其中 d 带中心差为 1.64 eV 的定制不对称局部电子环境导致 *CO 吸附能差为 0.8 eV。这使得*CO能够从弱吸附Ag位点连续解吸，并单向传输到强吸附Cu位点，从而促进关键的*NOCO形成。这项工作为节能尿素合成建立了一条有前途的途径。

articles.title:
Design and Demonstration
of a Direct Air Capture System
with Moisture-Driven CO2 Delivery into Aqueous Medium
articles.abstract: Abstract Two direct air capture (DAC) systems were designed and demonstrated to passively capture CO2 from ambient air and use moisture to release the CO2 into an alkaline medium. A bench-scale system delivering ∼1 g CO2 d–1 was demonstrated in a laminar flow hood, and a small pilot-scale system that could deliver ∼100 g CO2 d–1 was operated outdoors in a 4.2 m2 raceway pond. Novel elongated mesh-tube packets containing anion-exchange resin (AER) beads were found to reduce drying and CO2 loading time 4.3-fold compared to larger mesh bags. Technoeconomic analysis (TEA) estimates the cost of capturing CO2 into an alkaline solution, suitable for cultivating photosynthetic microorganisms, to be $229 per tonne for a practical scenario based on current results and $72 per tonne for an aspirational scenario considering improvements to sorbent capacity, hydrophobicity, and sorbent lifetime. TEA further estimates an additional $110 per tonne to extract CO2 from solution, purify it, and compress it to 15 MPa, suitable for sequestration. Moisture-driven processes have the potential to use up to 87% less energy than thermal and/or vacuum swing DAC by using energy from water evaporation.
articles.title_zh:
设计与演示
直接空气捕获系统
将水分驱动的 CO2 输送到水性介质中
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 设计并演示了两种直接空气捕获 (DAC) 系统，可从环境空气中被动捕获 CO2，并利用水分将 CO2 释放到碱性介质中。在层流罩中演示了可提供约 1 g CO2 d–1 的实验室规模系统，并在室外 4.2 m2 跑道池中运行了可提供约 100 g CO2 d–1 的小型中试规模系统。研究发现，与较大的网袋相比，含有阴离子交换树脂 (AER) 珠的新型细长网管包可将干燥和 CO2 装载时间缩短 4.3 倍。技术经济分析 (TEA) 估计，根据目前的结果，将 CO2 捕获到适合培养光合微生物的碱性溶液中的成本为每吨 229 美元，考虑到吸附剂容量、疏水性和吸附剂寿命的改进，理想情况下的成本为每吨 72 美元。 TEA 进一步估计每吨额外花费 110 美元，用于从溶液中提取二氧化碳、净化二氧化碳并将其压缩至适合封存的 15 MPa。通过利用水蒸发的能量，湿气驱动工艺的能耗比热和/或真空摆动 DAC 的能耗可减少高达 87%。

articles.title:
How Are We Exposed
to Chemicals When Drugs Are Smoked
Indoors?
articles.abstract: Abstract Indoor smoking of psychoactive substances exposes not only users through “firsthand smoke” (FHS) but also bystanders through pathways of “secondhand smoke” (SHS; exhaled or side-stream smoke) and “thirdhand smoke” (THS; residual contamination that persists indoors) via different routes of inhalation, mouthing-mediated ingestion, and dermal absorption. Here, we explore how chemical properties, smoking behaviors, and features of exposed individuals together shape exposure pathways and routes, using a mechanistic indoor chemical fate and exposure model with scenarios varying by retention rate (the fraction of smoke-generated chemicals absorbed by the smoker) and smoking frequency. We estimate adult and child exposure to seven representative compounds spanning orders-of-magnitude differences in volatility and hydrophobicity. We find that dominant exposure pathways and routes are strongly chemical-specific and scenario-dependent. FHS is consistently the dominant exposure pathway for substance users, whereas among nonsmoking exposed individuals, the relative importance of SHS and THS is determined jointly by chemical partitioning properties and the relative durations of active-smoking and postsmoking periods. Exposure to volatile chemicals (e.g., nicotine) is dominated by inhalation, exposure to compounds with intermediate hydrophobicity by dermal absorption, while highly hydrophobic, lowly volatile compounds (e.g., Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol) receive meaningful contributions from all three routes. These findings highlight that broad generalizations about exposure dominance can misrepresent risks, particularly for nonusers and children.
articles.title_zh:
我们如何暴露
吸毒时接触化学物质
在室内？
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 室内吸食精神活性物质不仅会通过“一手烟”（FHS）暴露使用者，还会通过不同的吸入途径、口腔介导的摄入和皮肤吸收，通过“二手烟”（SHS；呼出或侧流烟雾）和“三手烟”（THS；室内持续的残留污染）途径使旁观者暴露。在这里，我们使用机械室内化学命运和暴露模型，探索化学性质、吸烟行为和暴露个体的特征如何共同塑造暴露途径和途径，其中场景随保留率（吸烟者吸收的烟雾产生的化学物质的比例）和吸烟频率而变化。我们估计了成人和儿童接触七种代表性化合物的情况，这些化合物的挥发性和疏水性存在数量级的差异。我们发现主要的暴露途径和途径具有很强的化学特异性和情景依赖性。 FHS 始终是物质使用者的主要暴露途径，而在不吸烟暴露个体中，SHS 和 THS 的相对重要性由化学分配特性以及主动吸烟和吸烟后时期的相对持续时间共同决定。接触挥发性化学物质（例如尼古丁）主要是通过吸入，接触具有中等疏水性的化合物是通过皮肤吸收，而高度疏水性、低挥发性化合物（例如Δ9-四氢大麻酚）则从所有三种途径中获得有意义的贡献。这些发现强调，对暴露主导的广泛概括可能会歪曲风险，特别是对于非使用者和儿童而言。

articles.title: Wastewater-Derived Comammox Nitrospira for Next-Generation Wastewater Management
articles.abstract: Abstract The discovery of complete ammonia-oxidizing (comammox) Nitrospira in 2015 marked a major advance in our understanding of the nitrogen cycle and demonstrated that a single microorganism can catalyze the full oxidation of ammonia to nitrate, challenging the long-standing paradigm that separates ammonia- and nitrite-oxidizing microorganisms. Over the past decade, research on comammox has progressed rapidly from genomic discovery to detailed characterization of its physiology, kinetics, and ecological distribution across natural and engineered ecosystems. Wastewater-derived comammox Nitrospira have emerged as influential players in biological nitrogen transformations due to their exceptionally high substrate affinities, metabolic versatility, potentially low nitrous oxide emissions, and resilience under resource-limited conditions. These traits position comammox as promising catalysts for low-energy and sustainable nitrogen management in engineered systems. This review synthesizes the first decade of research on comammox Nitrospira, with a particular focus on wastewater-associated lineages. We examine the ecological niches that enable comammox Nitrospira to thrive in wastewater environments and analyze their competitive and cooperative interactions with canonical ammonia- and nitrite-oxidizing microorganisms. Building on these ecological insights, we discuss emerging comammox-centered biotechnological strategies for next-generation wastewater treatment and resource recovery. By linking microbial ecology with process engineering, this review highlights the potential for comammox-driven innovations to advance circular and energy-efficient nitrogen management in the coming decade.
articles.title_zh: 废水衍生 氨氧化酶 硝化螺旋 用于下一代废水处理 管理
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 2015 年完全氨氧化（comammox）Nitrospira 的发现标志着我们对氮循环理解的重大进步，并证明单一微生物可以催化氨完全氧化为硝酸盐，挑战了长期以来区分氨氧化微生物和亚硝酸盐氧化微生物的范式。在过去的十年中，comammox 的研究迅速进展，从基因组发现到其生理学、动力学和在自然和工程生态系统中的生态分布的详细表征。源自废水的comammox Nitrospira因其极高的底物亲和力、代谢多功能性、潜在的低一氧化二氮排放以及在资源有限条件下的恢复能力而成为生物氮转化中具有影响力的参与者。这些特性使comammox成为工程系统中低能耗和可持续氮管理的有前途的催化剂。本综述综合了前十年对comammox Nitrospira 的研究，特别关注与废水相关的谱系。我们研究了使comammox Nitrospira在废水环境中茁壮成长的生态位，并分析了它们与典型的氨氧化和亚硝酸盐氧化微生物的竞争和合作相互作用。基于这些生态见解，我们讨论了以comammox为中心的下一代废水处理和资源回收的新兴生物技术策略。通过将微生物生态学与过程工程联系起来，这篇综述强调了comammox驱动的创新在未来十年推进循环和节能氮管理的潜力。

articles.title:
Multi-Element
(C, N, Cl) Stable Isotope Fractionation
During Reductive Dechlorination of Chloroanilines
articles.abstract: Abstract Compound-specific isotope analysis (CSIA) is widely used to verify in situ biodegradation of organic contaminants. Chloroanilines are persistent groundwater pollutants known to undergo reductive dechlorination under environmental conditions, yet their isotope fractionation remains unclear. This study reports multi-element isotopic fractionation (ε) associated with reductive dechlorination of 2,3-dichloroaniline (2,3-DCA) and 2-chloroaniline (2-CA) using a Dehalobacter-dominated enrichment culture. During 2,3-DCA dechlorination, significant C (εC = −8.1 ± 0.3‰) and Cl (εCl = −7.5 ± 0.1‰) isotope fractionation was observed (ΛC–Cl = 1.12 ± 0.09), while N isotope fractionation was insignificant (Δδ15N < 1‰). Similarly, reductive dechlorination of 2-CA yielded εC = −8.9 ± 0.3‰ and εCl = −18.1 ± 0.4‰ (ΛC–Cl = 0.48 ± 0.03), with negligible changes in δ15N. The large and comparable apparent kinetic isotope effects for C and Cl may suggest that both reactions share similar transition-state characteristics, with C–Cl bond cleavage as the rate-limiting step. In contrast to isotope fractionation reported for aerobic 2,3-DCA biodegradation, the distinct isotope patterns observed here enable differentiation between aerobic and anaerobic pathways. Using groundwater samples from a chloroaniline-impacted aquifer, we show that multi-element CSIA can help distinguish reductive dechlorination from aerobic biodegradation under spatially and temporally variable redox conditions.
articles.title_zh:
多元素
(C, N, Cl) 稳定同位素分馏
氯苯胺还原脱氯过程中
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 化合物特异性同位素分析（CSIA）广泛用于验证有机污染物的原位生物降解。氯苯胺是持久性地下水污染物，已知在环境条件下会发生还原脱氯，但其同位素分馏仍不清楚。本研究报告了使用 Dehalobacter 为主的富集培养物与 2,3-二氯苯胺 (2,3-DCA) 和 2-氯苯胺 (2-CA) 还原脱氯相关的多元素同位素分馏 (ε)。在2,3-DCA脱氯过程中，观察到显着的C（εC = -8.1 ± 0.3‰）和Cl（εCl = -7.5 ± 0.1‰）同位素分馏（ΛC–Cl = 1.12 ± 0.09），而N同位素分馏不显着（Δδ15N < 1‰）。类似地，2-CA 的还原脱氯产生 εC = −8.9 ± 0.3‰ 和 εCl = −18.1 ± 0.4‰ (ΛC–Cl = 0.48 ± 0.03)，δ15N 的变化可以忽略不计。 C 和 Cl 的大且可比较的表观动力学同位素效应可能表明这两个反应具有相似的过渡态特征，其中 C-Cl 键断裂是限速步骤。与有氧 2,3-DCA 生物降解报道的同位素分馏相反，这里观察到的不同同位素模式能够区分需氧和厌氧途径。使用来自受氯苯胺影响的含水层的地下水样品，我们表明多元素 CSIA 可以帮助区分空间和时间变化的氧化还原条件下的还原脱氯和需氧生物降解。

articles.title:
Interactions between
a Methanogenic Archaeon and Synthetic
Musk Tonalide: A Balance of Cellular Inhibition and Detoxifying Biotransformation
articles.abstract: Abstract The widespread use of synthetic musks, such as tonalide (AHTN), has led to their accumulation in anaerobic environments, such as sludge and sediments, raising concerns about their ecological impact. While methanogenic archaea are key ecological players in these environments, their responses to synthetic musks remain poorly understood. This study provides a systematic investigation of the interaction between AHTN and model methanogenic archaeon Methanosarcina acetivorans C2A. We found that AHTN toxicity is dependent on concentration, with 2 mg/L significantly inhibiting methanogenesis and growth by inducing oxidative stress and compromising cell membrane integrity. Despite this effect, M. acetivorans C2A was found to partially biotransform AHTN, achieving a value of 17.75% within 36 h. Using GC-MS/MS, six mono- and dihydroxylated metabolites were tentatively identified, indicating oxidation as the primary transformation mechanism. Notably, ecotoxicity modeling (ECOSAR) predicted these metabolites to be substantially less toxic than the parent AHTN, suggesting that this biotransformation is a detoxification pathway. These findings present the first evidence of archaeally mediated biotransformation of AHTN, revealing a dual role for methanogens as both targets of pollution and active agents in its natural attenuation.
articles.title_zh:
之间的相互作用
产甲烷古菌和合成物
麝香托纳内酯：细胞抑制与解毒生物转化的平衡
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 合成麝香（如托纳内酯（AHTN））的广泛使用导致其在污泥和沉积物等厌氧环境中积累，引起了人们对其生态影响的担忧。虽然产甲烷古菌是这些环境中的关键生态参与者，但它们对合成麝香的反应仍然知之甚少。本研究对 AHTN 与模型产甲烷古菌 Methanosarcina acetivorans C2A 之间的相互作用进行了系统研究。我们发现 AHTN 毒性取决于浓度，2 mg/L 会通过诱导氧化应激和损害细胞膜完整性来显着抑制产甲烷和生长。尽管存在这种影响，但发现 M. acetivorans C2A 可以部分生物转化 AHTN，在 36 小时内达到 17.75% 的值。使用 GC-MS/MS，初步鉴定了六种单羟基和二羟基代谢物，表明氧化是主要的转化机制。值得注意的是，生态毒性模型 (ECOSAR) 预测这些代谢物的毒性远低于母体 AHTN，表明这种生物转化是一种解毒途径。这些发现提供了古菌介导的 AHTN 生物转化的第一个证据，揭示了产甲烷菌作为污染目标和自然衰减活性剂的双重作用。

articles.title:
Iron-Doped
Carbon Nanotubes Facilitate ZnO Interfacial
Charge Accumulation for Selective Singlet Oxygen Generation in Piezo-Photocatalytic
Microplastics Upcycling
articles.abstract: Abstract Efficient catalytic upcycling of microplastics (MPs) remains challenging due to uncontrolled reactive oxygen species (ROS) evolution pathways and the reliance on predepolymerization of MPs prior to catalytic conversion. Here, we demonstrate that interfacial band engineering in an iron-doped carbon nanotube (CNFe)-mediated zinc oxide/carbon nitride (ZnO/DCN-Cg, ZCN) heterojunction enables selective ROS steering toward a dominant nonradical pathway. The ZCNCNFe nanocomposite, featuring N–Zn bonding, C–O–Zn coordination, and C–C conjugation, provides a structurally integrated platform that dynamically regulates interfacial charge transfer during peroxymonosulfate activation, resulting in singlet oxygen (1O2) as the dominant ROS with a high yield (67.71 μmol/L). Notably, real-world HDPE MPs (∼700 mg), directly extracted from commercial facial cleansers via a novel dual-density separation method, were selectively oxidized into oxygenated intermediates (e.g., carboxylic acids and esters) without any predepolymerization, rather than being fully mineralized (∼39.2 wt % weight loss, TOC = 14.06 mg/L), accompanied by pronounced surface erosion and fragmentation under piezo-photocatalysis. The introduction of CNFe triggers Fermi-level realignment to accelerate interfacial charge flux toward ZnO adsorption sites, promoting peroxo bond polarization and cleavage, driving the self-disproportionation of HSO5– to generate 1O2. This study establishes a charge-transfer-regulated framework for steering ROS pathways in piezo-photocatalytic systems, challenging conventional radical-dominated approaches for microplastics upcycling.
articles.title_zh:
掺铁
碳纳米管有利于 ZnO 界面
压电光催化中选择性单线态氧生成的电荷积累
微塑料升级再造
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 由于不受控制的活性氧 (ROS) 演化途径以及催化转化前对 MP 预解聚的依赖，微塑料 (MP) 的高效催化升级改造仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们证明了铁掺杂碳纳米管（CNFe）介导的氧化锌/氮化碳（ZnO/DCN-Cg，ZCN）异质结中的界面带工程能够选择性地将ROS转向主导的非自由基途径。 ZCNCNFe纳米复合材料具有N-Zn键合、C-O-Zn配位和C-C共轭等特点，提供了一个结构集成的平台，可以在过一硫酸盐活化过程中动态调节界面电荷转移，从而以单线态氧（1O2）作为主要ROS，并具有高产率（67.71 μmol/L）。值得注意的是，通过新型双密度分离方法直接从商业洗面奶中提取的现实世界中的 HDPE MP（~700 mg），在没有任何预解聚的情况下被选择性氧化成含氧中间体（例如羧酸和酯），而不是完全矿化（~39.2 wt% 重量损失，TOC = 14.06 mg/L），并在压电光催化下伴随着明显的表面侵蚀和破碎。 CNFe的引入引发费米能级重排，加速界面电荷通量流向ZnO吸附位点，促进过氧键极化和裂解，驱动HSO5–自歧化生成1O2。这项研究建立了一个电荷转移调节框架，用于控制压电光催化系统中的 ROS 路径，挑战传统的自由基主导的微塑料升级回收方法。

articles.title:
Potential of Microalgal
Biomass Production in Coastal
Deserts for Carbon Dioxide Removal
articles.abstract: Abstract High photosynthetic yields and the ability to grow without fresh water make microalgae interesting mechanisms for carbon dioxide removal (CDR). We characterize two CDR systems which grow microalgae in seawater in coastal deserts─microalgal bioenergy with carbon capture and storage and microalgal biomass burial─and evaluate their potential when using carbon sourced from the atmosphere or ocean to meet CDR objectives via a comparison with direct air carbon capture and storage (DACCS). By deriving and validating a theoretical model of chemically enhanced carbon dioxide mass transfer, we identify the importance of gas–liquid mass transfer into raceway ponds as limiting microalgal productivities and determining technoeconomic viability. Our analysis shows that, while microalgal CDR cannot compete with DACCS in the areal productivity of removals, net removal costs with marine carbon supply are only slightly higher than DACCS with prospects for parity. Though such outcomes may not yet support the use of microalgal biomass for CDR, the carbon supply apparatuses outlined and the theoretical models accompanying them can inform ongoing research into microalgal cultivation without carbon addition for diverse applications.
articles.title_zh:
微藻的潜力
沿海生物质生产
沙漠去除二氧化碳
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 高光合产量和无需淡水即可生长的能力使微藻成为二氧化碳去除（CDR）的有趣机制。我们描述了在沿海沙漠海水中生长微藻的两种 CDR 系统（具有碳捕获和储存的微藻生物能源和微藻生物质埋藏），并通过与直接空气碳捕获和储存 (DACCS) 进行比较，评估了它们在使用来自大气或海洋的碳来实现 CDR 目标时的潜力。通过推导和验证化学增强二氧化碳传质的理论模型，我们确定了气液传质进入跑道池的重要性，因为它限制了微藻生产力并确定了技术经济可行性。我们的分析表明，虽然微藻 CDR 在清除面积生产力方面无法与 DACCS 竞争，但海洋碳供应的净清除成本仅略高于 DACCS，且具有同等前景。尽管这些结果可能尚不支持使用微藻生物质进行 CDR，但概述的碳供应装置及其随附的理论模型可以为正在进行的不添加碳的微藻培养研究提供信息，以用于不同的应用。

articles.title:
Exploring
the High
Summertime Surface Ozone-Temperature
Sensitivity in China
articles.abstract: Abstract Ozone-temperature sensitivity measures the increase in ozone concentration per Kelvin rise in temperature, serving as a critical metric for assessing ozone responses to climate warming. Here, from extensive observations across the Northern Hemisphere, we show that China exhibits a remarkably higher present-day (2017–2024) summertime surface ozone-temperature sensitivity (mΔO3-ΔTmax; 3.7 ppbv K–1) compared to the US (1.6 ppbv K–1) and Europe (1.8 ppbv K–1), with extremely high values reaching 8–10 ppbv K–1 at the site level. GEOS-Chem model simulations with improved accuracy in reproducing observed mΔO3-ΔTmax attribute this elevated sensitivity predominantly to temperature-indirect effects (66%), comprising comparable contributions from temperature-associated changes in radiation (44%) and transport patterns (51%). These indirect effects dominate the spatial and interannual variability of mΔO3-ΔTmax in China. Direct temperature effects on emissions, chemistry, and deposition account for the remaining 34%. Global models project that stringent emission reductions will decrease China’s future mΔO3-ΔTmax to levels comparable to those of the US and Europe, highlighting emission levels as the primary determinant of the magnitude of ozone-temperature sensitivity. These findings emphasize that sustained emission controls are crucial for mitigating the risks associated with compound heat and ozone pollution.
articles.title_zh:
探索
高
夏季地表臭氧温度
中国的敏感性
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 臭氧温度敏感性测量温度每升高一开尔文，臭氧浓度的增加量，作为评估臭氧对气候变暖反应的关键指标。在这里，通过对北半球的广泛观测，我们发现，与美国（1.6 ppbv K-1）和欧洲（1.8 ppbv K-1）相比，中国目前（2017-2024）夏季表面臭氧温度敏感性（mΔO3-ΔTmax；3.7 ppbv K-1）显着更高，现场值极高，达到8-10 ppbv K-1水平。 GEOS-Chem 模型模拟在再现观测到的 mΔO3-ΔTmax 方面具有更高的准确性，这主要归因于温度间接效应 (66%)，其中包括与温度相关的辐射 (44%) 和传输模式 (51%) 变化的类似贡献。这些间接影响主导了中国 mΔO3-ΔTmax 的空间和年际变化。温度对排放、化学和沉积的直接影响占剩余的 34%。全球模型预测，严格的减排将使中国未来的 mΔO3-ΔTmax 降低至与美国和欧洲相当的水平，这凸显了排放水平是臭氧-温度敏感性大小的主要决定因素。这些发现强调，持续的排放控制对于减轻与复合热和臭氧污染相关的风险至关重要。
